'''September 2000 Vancouver tournament (2 September)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Vancouver, BC, Canada on 2 September 2000. [[Ryan Mathison]] won it. It is known from Ryan Mathison's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1206">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-06-vancouver-bc-canada-9-2-00d1206/ vancouver-bc-canada-9-2-00], DeckTech (Ryan "Cradossk" Mathison, 6 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-06-vancouver-bc-canada-9-2-00d1206/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 2 September 2000
* '''Site:''' Vancouver, BC, Canada
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Ryan Mathison]]
